# Sakan AI

> Agentic deal-intelligence platform for Dubai real estate. A five-agent
> pipeline (Query, Comps, Valuation, Compliance, Memo) turns a plain-English
> question into cited comparable sales, a defensible valuation range, a RERA
> compliance check, and an investor-ready memo — every claim traceable to a
> real transaction record or a cited regulatory clause, never fabricated.

## Product

- [Home](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/): Ask a deal question, see the live agent pipeline run.
- [Pricing](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/pricing): Starter/Pro/Team plans and quota limits.
- [Comps Explorer](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/comps): Filterable comparable-sales search.
- [Analytics](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/market): Market trends, developer leaderboard, off-plan funnel.
- [Market guides](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/guides): Community-by-community and property-type price data, computed from real transaction records.
- [System status](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/status): Live backend/database/cache/vector-search health.

- [Terms of Service](https://sakan-agentic-ai.vercel.app/legal/terms)

## Notes

- Demo deployment runs on synthetic and public-dataset transaction data, not
  a licensed DLD feed — see the Market guides pages for exact data provenance
  per figure.
- The regulatory corpus backing the Compliance Agent is currently unreviewed
  by counsel; every compliance answer says so explicitly rather than
  implying legal sign-off.
